description: Election Commission - K. A. D. V. Nanayakkara was elected as the member of the Kotikawatta Mulleriyawa Pradeshiya Sabaha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local authority (Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a death, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process of nomination by a political party and the official declaration of a newly elected member. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and declarations, making it a Type 7 (Elections) gazette.
